verses.salla-alayka-l-lahu-ya-khayra-l-wara-c1-: ṣallā ʿalayka llāhu yā khayra l-warā yā man bihi ʿannā l-ʿadhābu yazūlu
yā ʾummaha l-hādī bihi yanhīkumu fal-qadru ʿāli wal-maqāmu jalīlu
nazala l-kitābu muṣarriḥā bithanāʾihi wakadhalika t-tawrāta wal-ʾinjīlu
surra l-masīḥu bihi washurrifa ʾādamu wasamā bihi mūsā wasāda khalīlu
fal-kullu minhum taḥta ẓili liwāʾihi yawma l-jazāʾi ʾidhi l-wuqūqu ṭawīlu
fatabarrakū bimadīḥihi wabidhikrihi falahu ntahā t-taʿẓīmu wat-tabjīlu
ʾanjā waʾanqadha min ʿadhābi wāqiʿi wahadā waʾarshada wal-ḥabību kafīlu
ṣallā l-ʾilahu ʿalā n-nabiyyī wāʾālihi waṣ-ṣaḥbi mā ʿtaqaba ṣ-ṣabāḥi ʾaṣīlu
